page_title: LUT 4-0 BHA | Luton v Brighton 30/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Cauley Woodrow (Luton) sends an accurate short pass. Chiedozie Ogbene controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Robert Jones blows the whistle, Gabriel Osho (Luton) is penalised for a foul.
87' A cross from Andros Townsend (Luton) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
85' The shots on goal statistics – 8:2.
83' Carlton Morris (Luton) gets inside the box and tries to beat Jason Steele with a measured shot into the left side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
82' Rob Edwards has decided to substitute Carlton Morris and he is replaced by Cauley Woodrow (Luton).
82' The referee allows time for a substitution. Ross Barkley will be replaced by Luke Berry (Luton).
81' Thomas Kaminski (Luton) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
79' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brighton comes to nothing.
79' Brighton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
73' Yellow card. Carlos Baleba (Brighton) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
71' Substitution. Jakub Moder (Brighton) in, Joao Pedro out.
71' Substitution. Elijah Adebayo did his best and is replaced by Tahith Chong (Luton).
68' The manager makes a subsitution with Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) coming on for Albert Sambi Lokonga.
68' Rob Edwards has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Andros Townsend (Luton) replacing Jordan Clark.
65' What was Jordan Clark (Luton) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
63' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
61' That's the end of the game for Billy Gilmour, who is replaced by Carlos Baleba (Brighton).
58' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) and Joao Pedro perform a quick tiki-taka to get past two defenders and then continue the move along the side line.

56' 4 - 0 Elijah Adebayo (Luton) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the left side of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 4:0.
56' Luton force their opponents to concede a corner.
51' Brighton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
49' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Luton players look gutted.
49' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Robert Jones is going to take a look using VAR.
48' Jordan Clark (Luton) has a goal ruled out for offside!
46' Half-time substitution. Roberto De Zerbi decided to make a change. Pervis Estupinan is replaced by Tariq Lamptey (Brighton).
46' Roberto De Zerbi has made a change at the break. Evan Ferguson (Brighton) has come on in place of Facundo Buonanotte.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Luton seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

42' 3 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Ross Barkley slips the ball through to Elijah Adebayo (Luton), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 3:0.
41' The linesman signals that Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
39' Alfie Doughty (Luton) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
39' Jordan Clark (Luton) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
38' Alfie Doughty (Luton) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
36' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Robert Jones blows his whistle for an infringement.
35' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
34' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
32' Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Thomas Kaminski, who smothers the ball.
31' Joao Pedro (Brighton) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
29' Pascal Gross (Brighton) has a sight of goal and shoots goalwards, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
29' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
26' Luton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
25' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Albert Sambi Lokonga (Luton) was quite harsh and Robert Jones didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

25' Jordan Clark (Luton) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Jason Steele anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the bottom right corner.
24' The resulting set piece from Luton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
24' Reece Burke (Luton) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
23' The Brighton players are exchanging some short passes.
20' James Milner is substituted due to injury. Roberto De Zerbi gives a chance to Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton).
19' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Robert Jones who sees an offensive foul.
18' James Milner (Brighton) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
16' The game is interrupted now, James Milner (Brighton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
14' It seemed like Ross Barkley (Luton) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
13' Igor (Brighton) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
12' The ball falls kindly for Danny Welbeck (Brighton) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just wide of the right post.
9' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but James Milner (Brighton) takes it short.
9' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Joao Pedro (Brighton).
7' Joao Pedro (Brighton) attempts to find Danny Welbeck, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
3' 2 - 0 Goal! Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) seizes on the loose ball after a huge error from Jason Steele and finds the back of the net from inside the box. 2:0.
1' 1 - 0 Elijah Adebayo (Luton) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the middle of the goal, and thus alter the score to 1:0.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Brighton will have the kick-off.
Robert Jones is introduced as the referee for today's match.
